notes: Issue prep: when you name a topic for the group during the monthly check-in, it asks whether you want to prep an Opportunity / Issue Processing Form for it. Say yes and it walks you through the form's questions one at a time, reads it back, and hands you the finished form as a Word file, one page, in the same layout as the one we use. It never preps one you didn't ask for, and it never suggests options for you; that's the group's job.
